source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The nsIScriptError migration changes MsgLogToConsole4 declaration, definition, historical macros and call sites together. Current error text remains nsAString while the filename is nsCString; Init no longer receives the old sourceLine argument. Newer current callers use nsDependentCString(__FILE__) rather than the owned nsCString copy in the 2024 patch. Manual C++ review proposal for this API: follow the receiving string type and lifetime when choosing a wrapper; do not convert a filename to UTF-16 merely because the diagnostic text is Unicode. This is a specific console boundary, not a repository-wide mandate for one nsString class. POP warning code and console macros from the historical patch are retired in the fixed source.
title: Mailnews console helpers keep filenames as byte strings and error text as Unicode
